extras: Mobile optimized and supports extended checkbox statuses.
intentEvidence: iCalendar is an Obsidian calendar plugin that visualizes and manages tasks from both daily notes and project files in an interactive calendar view.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of visualizing and managing tasks spread across daily notes and various project files.

relations.evidence: Tasks come from two sources, each with its own color on the calendar: - Daily note tasks — compatible with the built-in Obsidian daily notes plugin.

summary: iCalendar is a calendar plugin that visualizes and manages tasks sourced from daily notes and project files in an interactive view.
